# TDA Miku local experiment

Source: [TDA Miku (with bones), Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/tda-miku-with-bones-b8c3d6ca7d0840b8a00e500e1008d88b).

The locally downloaded `tda_miku_with_bones.glb` is excluded from Git. The owner
of this workspace has not authorized redistributing this model. Commit notes
and links only; do not commit the model, embedded/extracted textures, or exports.

The local ship copy is `examples/local/ship_interior.mms`. Its cafeteria vendor
uses this model instead of Lumae. This export has replacement characters in many
bone names; the local prototype selects the right hand using its exact exported
name. Rig/pose refinement belongs in the ignored local example files.
